description: Open-source vector database and sub-microsecond key-value store in one Go engine — embed it as a library, run it standalone, or replicate it across a Raft cluster. HNSW/IVF/Vamana indexes, quantization, hybrid dense+sparse and BM25 search, WASM stored procedures. Apache-2.0.
